name: Natron Explosion

source.title: Pathfinder Society Scenario #3-14: The Tomb Between Worlds

disable: DC 30 Thievery check (expert) to safely remove the umbral vise from the tub without triggering the natron or Dispel Magic (5th rank; counteract DC 28) to counteract the ritual energy.

items.name: Mummify
items.text:
Trigger A creature touches or disturbs the umbral vise.

---

Effect Natron sprays out of the tub, infusing all creatures adjacent to the tub with void energy and desiccating their internal organs. Each creature takes 2d10+4 void damage and 2d10+4 poison damage (DC 32 basic Fortitude save save). On a failure, the internal damage makes the creature more susceptible to other effects that would cause it to mummify, such as Mummy Rot. For 1 day, the first time it is exposed to such an effect, it uses the outcome one degree of success worse than the result of its saving throw.

text: Negative-energy charged natron sprays out of the tub and starts to mummify nearby creatures.
